Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Not every seller comes to Square directly. A growing number reach us through resellers who sell Square on our behalf, and through independent contractors who represent Square in their own communities. Together these two motions make up our channel sales function.

As Senior Marketing Manager, Channel Sales, you will own marketing for both motions worldwide. You will be the primary marketing point of contact for the global channel sales team, turning what they need into programmes that scale. Most of your time will go into building scalable solutions that equip every reseller and contractor to sell Square well. The rest will be spent working shoulder to shoulder with our highest-performing resellers on activity that grows both their business and ours.

You will partner closely with channel sales leadership, events, content and regional marketing teams.

You Will

  • Serve as the marketing point of contact for the global channel sales team, triaging incoming requests, prioritising them and shaping them into a coherent programme of work.
  • Build and run a scaled co-marketing hub that gives resellers and independent contractors the campaigns, content and guidance they need to sell Square in their own markets.
  • Partner directly with our top-performing resellers on demand generation campaigns that grow and convert their pipeline.
  • Equip both motions to sell effectively, including through content and events.
  • Work with our independent contractor and reseller network to extend Square's brand presence and build awareness / credibility in the communities they serve.
  • Review incentive programmes that reward the strongest-performing resellers and contractors, partnering with the cross-functional teams who deliver different components of the programme to ensure and report back on success against objectives.
  • Define how co-marketing funds work for this channel, setting out how funds are allocated, spent and measured.
  • Work with sales to define an effective recruitment programme for resellers and independent contractors.
  • Build a valued community that our resellers and independent contractors are proud to be a part of.
  • Measure and report on programme performance.

You Have

  • 8+ years of relevant marketing experience.
  • Direct experience marketing through a channel, reseller, distributor or independent sales model.
  • A strong background in B2B marketing, ideally within technology companies.
  • Experience building enablement and co-marketing programmes that partners adopt and use at scale.
  • Proven ability to own programmes end to end, from design through to execution and measurement.
  • Experience designing incentive or reward programmes in partnership with a sales team.
  • Experience working across international markets and with globally distributed teams.
  • Strong stakeholder, communication and project management skills.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. About the team

The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.

Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.

At Stripe’s scale—$1.9T in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Staff Product Manager for Risk, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.

You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.

You will partner closely with Risk leadership to shape the organization’s strategy, vision, and most important investments.   • Coach and mentor PMs across Risk, helping them strengthen their product judgment, technical depth, strategic thinking, and execution.

We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. Preferred qualifications
